why_important: Line coverage for the target source module.
Failing/error tests divided by total executed tests. Higher means defects are found with fewer tests.
Measured pytest execution time for the benchmarked test set. For agentic mode this is the selected/generated target tests, not the full LLM pipeline setup time.
Total pytest outcomes counted from the final pytest summary: passed + failed + errors + skipped + xfailed + xpassed.
How many fewer tests were executed compared with the traditional target-test baseline.
Passed tests divided by total executed tests.
Agentic only: generated tests that executed without collection/runtime infrastructure errors. Failing assertions still count as valid defect-detection tests.
Coverage difference compared with the traditional target-test baseline.
Selected test files that directly target the source module divided by all selected test files.
Transparent proxy estimate from executed tests/heal attempts. Use only as an automation-effort indicator, not measured human time.
Weighted index from defect density, test reduction, execution saving, coverage, pass rate, and selection accuracy.
